mechanism: Both drugs affect dopaminergic and monoaminergic systems; deutetrabenazine inhibits VMAT2 (increasing monoamine depletion) while pramipexole is a dopamine agonist, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects with potential for reduced efficacy and additive CNS depression.
action: Monitor clinical response and CNS side effects closely; dose adjustments may be necessary; use caution as combination may reduce efficacy of both agents.
